object.attr: derived: failure analysis CF-G3, CF-G26, CF-G60 (D-G4). After a fatal error or a kill the user can't tell whether the last typed text was saved, and the next start is the only point where Mellon can say so.
object.description: When the GUI starts after the GUI's previous run ended without closing the GUI's windows, the GUI shall say that Mellon ended unexpectedly and name the error log.
